author: CMS-L1T-Jet-Tagging
body:
This PR updates the CMSSW externals for the NGJet model to v2.1.0

See the https://github.com/cms-hls4ml/L1TSC4NGJetModel/releases/tag/v2.1.0 release notes for what models are in this release

This PR is needed for CMSSW PR: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51267
title: Update NGJet models cms-hls4ml tag v2.1.0
